claim: The sample demo stores only demo data, and Reset demo removes it.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo/; assert the demo namespace is the only local key and reset removes it.

claim: The demo fits phone and desktop screens.
sandbox: Desktop and 390px projects enter through /?demo=1, use Stable mode, reset, and assert no horizontal overflow.

claim: The motion report identifies the sample motion, and Stable mode stops each sample type without changing its text.
where: Landing hero and How it works, Demo, README, .factory/catalog-description.txt
sandbox: Fresh demo; assert exact counts, enable Stable mode, add later motion, and inspect computed styles and retained text.

claim: The demo can allow media or keep sticky layers, and turning Stable mode off restores the sample.
where: Landing product facts and How it works, Demo, README, Terms
sandbox: Fresh demo; use both exceptions, assert selected behavior, turn Stable mode off, and assert restoration.

claim: Extension site settings stay in browser-local extension storage and can be exported or imported as a local JSON file without a remote request.
where: Landing hero and product facts, Privacy, README, extension popup
sandbox: Clean unpacked extension; set a site rule, export and parse JSON, clear extension storage, import with replace, reload the fixture, assert restored behavior and no remote requests.

claim: The extension does not send page text, form entries, scan counts, or browsing history to a server.
sandbox: Clean unpacked extension; attach request logging before any fixture page or popup opens, seed unique page-text, form, scan-result, and history values, inspect and enable Stable mode, then assert no remote request or remote payload contains a sentinel.

claim: The extension installs and runs in desktop Chromium.
where: Landing hero and install section, README
sandbox: Clean Chromium profile loads the unpacked MV3 build, opens the popup on a motion fixture, and receives a non-zero report.

claim: The website uses no analytics, advertising pixels, remote fonts, or runtime CDN scripts.
sandbox: Fresh context records the landing-to-demo interaction and asserts every request remains same-origin.

claim: The sample demo reloads offline after its first visit.
sandbox: Fresh per-test browser context; load /demo/, explicitly await registration, activation, and page control, go offline, reload, then operate Stable mode from cached CSS and JavaScript.

claim: Calm Scroll is not a medical device and does not promise a health outcome.
where: Landing product facts and limits, Terms, README
sandbox: Static copy contract checks the landing and Terms language for the non-clinical boundary.

claim: The extension is free software under the MIT License. You may inspect, modify, and redistribute it under that license.
where: Terms → Free software, README → License, LICENSE
sandbox: Clean checkout; build the extension, assert its shipped LICENSE matches the MIT grant, then visit /terms/ and assert the exact published free-software wording.
